summary.work_completed: Authored TDD test suite for NFR-PERF-001 (≥60 FPS). Three test IDs covered: T-PERF-PERF-001-01 (500 bricks p95 < 16.7ms), T-PERF-PERF-001-02 (100/250/500 scenarios), T-PERF-PERF-001-03 (regression guard). performanceMonitor utility created with zero production impact.
key_findings: Puppeteer SwiftShader WebGL (--use-gl=swiftshader) enables headless WebGL in CI without GPU
60-frame warmup discard eliminates scene-initialization overhead from p95 measurement
T-PERF-PERF-001-03 overrides requestAnimationFrame to simulate 33ms frames, validating the harness fails correctly on regression
performanceMonitor.ts is tree-shaken by Vite in production (import.meta.env.PROD guard)
Jest config uses bail:1 so CI stops immediately on first threshold breach

human_review_required.item: Dev server must be running for E2E performance tests
human_review_required.reason: Puppeteer tests require a live app at PERF_BASE_URL (default: http://localhost:5173). CI pipeline must start the dev server before running jest.performance.config.ts.
The injectBricks helper uses window.__legoScene.addBricks if available, falling back to synthetic DOM elements. The implementation agent must expose this API for accurate brick-count testing.

recommended_actions: Review frameRate.test.ts for correctness against LLD spec
Verify performanceMonitor.ts has zero production bundle impact (check Vite build output)
Confirm SwiftShader WebGL flags are appropriate for the CI environment
Check that jest.performance.config.ts is isolated from vitest.config.ts (no overlap)
Validate T-PERF-PERF-001-03 negative test logic correctly simulates regression
